voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: At the end of a lonely road in Indiana, a widow advertised for a husband.
Come in person, the advertisements said. Bring your money. And tell no one where you are going.
Dozens of men came. At least a dozen of them she buried in the hog pen behind the house.
Then her house burned to the ground — with a headless woman's body inside.
beats.cap:
A HEADLESS BODY
IN THE FIRE

beats.vo: The body was far too small to be her. And Belle Gunness was never seen again.
The full story is on the channel.
